heroTitle.zh: 弹塑性非线性有限元分析

heroSubtitle.en: Finite element analysis of elastic-plastic deformation in a structural component under cyclic loading, with material hardening, large deformation, and contact nonlinearity using Abaqus.
heroSubtitle.zh: 使用 Abaqus 对结构件在循环载荷下的弹塑性变形进行有限元分析，涵盖材料硬化、大变形与接触非线性。

s01Text1.en: Structural components in mechanical systems frequently experience loading conditions that drive material beyond the elastic limit, resulting in permanent plastic deformation. This project investigates the nonlinear elastic-plastic behavior of a structural component under cyclic loading using finite element analysis.
s01Text1.zh: 机械系统中的结构件经常在超出弹性极限的载荷条件下工作，导致材料发生永久塑性变形。本项目利用有限元方法研究结构件在循环载荷下的非线性弹塑性行为。

s01Text2.en: The analysis incorporates three sources of nonlinearity: material nonlinearity through isotropic hardening plasticity, geometric nonlinearity due to large deformation, and contact nonlinearity at mating interfaces. The objective was to characterize plastic strain accumulation and stress redistribution across multiple loading cycles.
s01Text2.zh: 分析综合考虑三种非线性来源：基于各向同性硬化的材料非线性、大变形引起的几何非线性，以及配合面之间的接触非线性。研究目标是表征多个加载循环中的塑性应变累积与应力重分布。

s02Text1.en: An implicit static analysis was performed in Abaqus/Standard using the Newton-Raphson incremental-iterative solution procedure. The elastic-plastic material model employed the von Mises yield criterion with isotropic hardening, calibrated to experimental stress-strain data.
s02Text1.zh: 在 Abaqus/Standard 中采用 Newton-Raphson 增量迭代解法进行隐式静力分析。弹塑性材料模型采用 von Mises 屈服准则与各向同性硬化，并根据实验应力-应变数据进行标定。

s02Text2.en: Contact pairs were defined between mating component surfaces using the penalty method with a finite-sliding formulation. Automatic time incrementation with line search was enabled to handle convergence difficulties during plastic flow and contact status changes.
s02Text2.zh: 在相互配合的组件表面之间使用罚函数法与有限滑移公式定义接触对。启用自动时间增量与线搜索，以处理塑性流动和接触状态变化过程中的收敛困难。

s03Text.en: The component was discretized using C3D8R reduced-integration hexahedral elements to balance accuracy and computational cost. A mesh convergence study was conducted for the nonlinear problem, with refinement applied in regions of anticipated high stress gradients and contact interfaces.
s03Text.zh: 采用 C3D8R 减缩积分六面体单元对结构件进行离散，以平衡计算精度与成本。针对该非线性问题开展了网格收敛性研究，并在预期高应力梯度区域和接触界面进行了局部加密。

s04Text.en: Equivalent plastic strain (PEEQ) distributions revealed localized plastic deformation in regions of geometric discontinuity. Stress concentration zones were identified and correlated with the onset of plastic flow. The load-displacement curves exhibited a clear elastic-plastic transition with progressive hardening across successive loading cycles.
s04Text.zh: 等效塑性应变（PEEQ）分布显示几何不连续处出现局部塑性变形。识别出应力集中区域，并将其与塑性流动的起始相关联。载荷-位移曲线呈现出明显的弹塑性过渡，并在连续加载循环中表现出渐进硬化。

captionPlasticStrain.en: Equivalent plastic strain after cyclic loading
captionPlasticStrain.zh: 循环加载后的等效塑性应变

s05Quote.en: Nonlinear FEA demands careful attention to convergence behavior — automatic time stepping with line search proved essential for navigating elastic-plastic transitions, while mesh refinement in contact regions was the dominant factor controlling solution accuracy in this class of problems.
s05Quote.zh: 非线性有限元分析需要特别关注收敛行为——自动时间步进与线搜索被证明对于穿越弹塑性过渡至关重要，而接触区域的网格细化则是控制该类问题求解精度的主导因素。

s05Cite.zh: —— 本项目关于非线性 FEA 方法论的结论

heroSubtitle.en: Design and structural analysis of an underactuated compliant gripper for delicate object manipulation, validated through FEA and 3D-printed prototypes.
heroSubtitle.zh: 设计并分析一种欠驱动柔顺抓爪，用于精密物体操作，通过有限元分析与 3D 打印原型进行验证。

s01Text.en: Traditional rigid grippers require precise force control to avoid damaging fragile objects. This project developed an underactuated compliant mechanism that passively adapts to object geometry, distributing grip force evenly across contact surfaces without active force feedback.
s01Text.zh: 传统刚性抓爪需要精确的力控制才能避免损坏脆弱物体。本项目开发了一种欠驱动柔顺机构，能够被动适应物体几何形状，无需主动力反馈即可在接触面上均匀分布夹持力。

s02Text.en: The gripper employs a four-bar linkage combined with flexural hinges to achieve underactuation. Three phalanges per finger provide progressive enveloping, with contact force determined by tendon routing geometry rather than active motor control.
s02Text.zh: 抓爪采用四连杆机构与柔性铰链相结合实现欠驱动。每根手指具有三个指节，提供渐进包络式抓取，接触力由腱绳布线几何决定，而非主动电机控制。

s03Text.en: Finite element analysis was performed in SolidWorks Simulation to evaluate stress distribution in flexural hinges under maximum loading. Peak von Mises stress remained below 60% of the material yield strength (ABS), confirming design robustness for repeated cycling.
s03Text.zh: 在 SolidWorks Simulation 中进行有限元分析，评估最大载荷下柔性铰链中的应力分布。峰值 von Mises 应力保持在材料屈服强度（ABS）的 60% 以下，证明该设计在反复循环中具有足够的稳健性。

s04Text.en: A functional prototype was 3D-printed in ABS and tested with objects ranging from 15 mm to 45 mm in diameter. The gripper successfully handled eggs, glass vials, and deformable objects without damage across 100+ test cycles.
s04Text.zh: 使用 ABS 材料 3D 打印了功能原型，并对直径 15 mm 至 45 mm 的物体进行了测试。抓爪在 100 多次测试循环中成功夹持鸡蛋、玻璃瓶和可变形物体且未造成损坏。

s05Quote.en: Compliant mechanisms offer a compelling alternative to sensor-heavy robotic end-effectors — passive mechanical intelligence, when properly designed through FEA-guided iteration, can achieve robust performance with simpler control architectures.
s05Quote.zh: 柔顺机构为依赖大量传感器的机器人末端执行器提供了一种有吸引力的替代方案——当通过 FEA 指导的迭代进行合理设计时，被动的机械智能可以在更简单的控制架构下实现稳健的性能。

s05Cite.en: — Design philosophy derived from prototype validation
s05Cite.zh: —— 源自原型验证的设计哲学

heroSubtitle.en: Density-based topology optimization of a structural bracket using the SIMP method, achieving significant mass reduction while maintaining structural integrity under multi-axial loading conditions.
heroSubtitle.zh: 采用 SIMP 方法对结构支架进行基于密度的拓扑优化，在多轴载荷条件下实现显著减重同时保持结构完整性。

s01Text.en: Structural brackets in mechanical systems must withstand severe multi-axial loads while contributing minimally to overall system mass. This project applied density-based topology optimization (SIMP method) to redesign a structural bracket for weight-critical applications.
s01Text.zh: 机械系统中的结构支架必须在承受严重多轴载荷的同时，尽可能降低对整体系统质量的贡献。本项目应用基于密度的拓扑优化方法（SIMP）重新设计了一款用于重量敏感应用的结构支架。

s02Text.en: The Solid Isotropic Material with Penalization (SIMP) method was implemented in MATLAB. The objective function minimized compliance subject to a 40% volume fraction constraint, with sensitivity filtering (rmin = 1.5 × element size) to prevent checkerboard patterns.
s02Text.zh: 在 MATLAB 中实现了带惩罚的各向同性固体材料（SIMP）方法。目标函数为在 40% 体积分数约束下最小化柔度，并采用灵敏度过滤（rmin = 1.5 倍单元尺寸）以防止棋盘格现象。

s03Text.en: Four critical load cases were considered: vertical, lateral, torsional, and combined multi-axial loading. Each load case was weighted in the objective function based on occurrence probability.
s03Text.zh: 考虑了四种关键载荷工况：垂直、横向、扭转以及组合多轴载荷。每种载荷工况根据发生概率在目标函数中赋予不同权重。

s04Text.en: The optimization converged in 78 iterations, producing an organic truss-like topology that differed significantly from the baseline design. The optimized geometry was reconstructed as a CAD model for FEA validation.
s04Text.zh: 优化在 78 次迭代后收敛，生成了与基线设计显著不同的有机桁架状拓扑。将优化后的几何重构为 CAD 模型，以便进行 FEA 验证。

s05Text.en: The optimized geometry was re-analyzed using FEA with a fine tetrahedral mesh. Von Mises stress distributions confirmed that all regions operated below the material fatigue limit with a minimum safety factor of 2.1 across all load cases.
s05Text.zh: 使用细密四面体网格对优化后的几何进行重新分析。Von Mises 应力分布确认所有区域均低于材料疲劳极限，在所有载荷工况下最小安全系数为 2.1。

s06Quote.en: Topology optimization is not a push-button solution — constraint formulation and load case weighting are as critical as the numerical solver. A poorly weighted multi-load optimization can converge to a design that is optimal on paper but impractical to manufacture.
s06Quote.zh: 拓扑优化不是一键式解决方案——约束 formulation 和载荷工况加权与数值求解器同样关键。一个加权不当的多载荷优化可能收敛到理论上最优但难以制造的设计。

s06Cite.zh: —— 本项目面向制造的设计评估
